Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in synthesizing the search results by incorrectly identifying "Raisen" (a district in India) as the intended entity for the query "Raisan Railway Station". The WebSurfer's search results explicitly listed "Raisan Railway Station" as a distinct entity located in Pakistan (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), separate from the Indian "Raisen" station. By ignoring the specific "Raisan" result in favor of the more common "Raisen" variant, the Planner failed to disambiguate the entity correctly, leading to the false conclusion that the stations are in different countries (Pakistan vs. India) when they are actually in the same country (Pakistan).
